brief: आज की रात — Hindi female-led party song. 120 seconds, approximately 124 BPM, 4/4. Dhol, dholak, electronic drums, synth bass, bright brass and group responses. Immediate rhythmic identity, playful verses and an easy sing-along chorus. Hook: “आज की रात खुल के जी / दिल की धुन पे चल पड़ी”. Celebratory and danceable, with a short percussion break and final chorus.

सैंडल पहनी, लाली लगाई
